# MiniMax H3 — 15s Fan Transformation Prompt

For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action cinematic fashion video, 15 seconds, vertical 9:16, one uninterrupted static overhead shot. Begin exactly from <Picture 1>.

Preserve the same adult East Asian woman’s facial identity, long black hair, body proportions, skin tone and elegant appearance. Preserve the muted-blue V-neck blouse, ivory-white fitted pencil skirt, smoky-grey hosiery and black pointed pumps shown in the opening image. Preserve the cream sofa, pale tiled floor, soft natural daylight, shadows, foreground wooden ceiling fan and all original spatial relationships.

CAMERA LOCK: the camera remains absolutely fixed throughout the entire 15-second video. Maintain exactly the same vertical overhead viewpoint, height, focal length, framing, perspective, exposure and orientation. No cut, zoom, push-in, pull-out, pan, tilt, tracking, orbit, camera roll, shake, reframing or composition drift.

FAN MOTION: the large wooden ceiling fan remains physically in front of the woman and rotates continuously clockwise as viewed from the camera. The fan hub remains fixed in exactly the same position on the left side of the frame. Preserve the original blade number, length, width, dark-brown wood texture and physical depth. The blades rotate at a slow, steady and constant speed with natural restrained motion blur. The fan never stops, reverses, accelerates, wobbles, deforms, changes size or disappears.

FULL-BODY COVERAGE RULE: the rotational sweep area of the fan must encompass the woman’s complete visible body from the top of her hair to the tips of both shoes. During every valid transformation passage, one designated master blade must physically sweep across and cumulatively occlude every visible region of the woman at least once: hair, forehead, face, neck, shoulders, both arms, both hands, chest, torso, waist, skirt, hips, thighs, knees, lower legs, hosiery and both shoes.

The master blade must not pass only across her chest, torso or waist. Its complete clockwise arc must begin above her head, cross her entire head-to-toe silhouette and finish below both shoes. The transformation is not complete until the blade has moved beyond the tips of both shoes. If any body region has not yet been covered by the master blade, that region must remain in the previous styling state.

Use the broad dark wooden blade crossing the woman’s torso in <Picture 1> as the master blade. Only this same identifiable master blade triggers transformations. Other blades continue rotating normally and produce foreground occlusion, but do not cause wardrobe, pose or facial-expression changes.

TRANSFORMATION MECHANISM: one complete valid master-blade sweep equals one complete styling transformation. A valid sweep begins when the master blade appears above the woman’s head. The transformation begins only when that blade first covers the top of her hair. As the same blade continues clockwise, the new outfit, new pose and new expression are revealed directly behind its trailing edge. Areas not yet reached by the blade retain the previous outfit, previous pose and previous expression.

At every intermediate moment, the frame visibly contains two styling states separated by the physical blade: the already-swept area shows the new state, while the unswept area remains in the old state. The boundary must stay attached to the blade’s trailing edge. Never transform the entire woman simultaneously.

INITIAL STATE — 00:00.000 to 00:02.000: preserve the exact appearance and posture shown in <Picture 1>. The woman wears a muted-blue V-neck blouse, ivory-white pencil skirt, smoky-grey hosiery and black pointed pumps. She reclines on the cream sofa with her legs crossed, one hand lightly touching her hair and the other resting beside her body. She looks toward the right side of the frame with a calm, thoughtful expression.

The master blade already crossing her torso in the opening frame continues its residual clockwise movement, sweeps across the remaining lower body and moves below the shoes. Because this blade did not begin above the head within the video, this incomplete residual passage must not trigger any transformation. The woman’s outfit, pose and expression remain completely unchanged. Only subtle breathing, one blink and slight hair movement are visible.

FIRST VALID FULL-BODY SWEEP — 00:02.000 to 00:05.000: the same master blade completes its rotation and reappears above the woman’s head. No change occurs before the blade touches her hair.

When the blade covers her hair and face, her head turns slightly toward the camera, her gaze becomes focused and confident, and her thoughtful expression changes into a calm, self-assured expression. Her facial identity and facial structure remain exactly the same.

As the blade covers her shoulders, arms and chest, the muted-blue blouse becomes the upper section of a fitted black tailored blazer dress with refined lapels and a slim metallic waist detail. One hand moves toward her waist and the other remains elegantly near her hair, but each arm changes position only while hidden behind the master blade.

As the blade continues across the torso, waist, hips and skirt, the ivory-white pencil skirt becomes the lower section of the black blazer dress. As it sweeps across the thighs, knees, lower legs and feet, the smoky-grey hosiery becomes black semi-sheer tights, her legs shift into an elegant crossed-at-the-ankles pose, and her shoes become glossy black pointed heels.

The same blade must cover both shoes before leaving the lower edge. At 00:05.000, when the master blade has moved completely below both shoe tips, the black tailored outfit, confident expression and new pose are fully complete.

HOLD — 00:05.000 to 00:06.000: retain the complete black outfit, confident expression and crossed-ankle pose. No other blade causes any change.

SECOND VALID FULL-BODY SWEEP — 00:06.000 to 00:09.000: the same master blade reappears above the woman’s head for the second transformation. The black styling remains unchanged until the blade covers the top of her hair.

Behind the blade, her head turns slightly toward the camera, her eyes soften and the corners of her lips form a restrained elegant smile. Small pearl earrings appear while her identity remains unchanged.

As the master blade covers the shoulders and arms, the black blazer dress becomes a sophisticated camel trench coat with refined wide lapels, structured shoulders, a belted waist and elegant tailoring. Her torso turns slightly to one side, one hand settles near her shoulder and the other rests beside her waist.

As the blade sweeps across the waist, hips and legs, the camel trench-coat silhouette becomes complete, her legs shift into a relaxed diagonal pose with gently bent knees, the black tights disappear beneath the new styling and the shoes become fitted black over-the-knee high-heeled boots with pointed toes and slim stiletto heels.

The master blade must cumulatively cover every part of the woman, including both hands, both knees and both boots. When it exits below both feet at 00:09.000, the camel trench-coat outfit, black over-the-knee high-heeled boots, side-turned pose and soft smile are complete.

HOLD — 00:09.000 to 00:10.000: retain the completed trench-coat styling without any change. The fan continues rotating clockwise at the same constant speed.

THIRD VALID FULL-BODY SWEEP — 00:10.000 to 00:13.000: the master blade reappears above the woman’s head for the final transformation. The trench-coat styling remains unchanged until the blade reaches her hair.

As the blade covers her head and face, she raises her chin slightly, her eyes become relaxed and luminous, and her restrained smile becomes a natural warm smile. Minimal crystal earrings and a softer arrangement of her long black hair appear behind the blade.

As it sweeps over her shoulders, arms and torso, the trench coat becomes a tasteful luxury black bikini with minimalist tailoring, refined satin edging and a structured supportive top. Compared with the previous trench-coat styling, the arm-position change must remain subtle and low-amplitude: the arm that was near her shoulder shifts only slightly higher and stays close to the head-and-shoulder area rather than lifting far above her head, while the other hand remains near her waist with only a small relaxed adjustment. The arm positions change only while physically hidden by the moving blade.

As the blade continues across her waist, hips, thighs, knees, lower legs and boots, the black bikini silhouette becomes complete with a coordinated high-waisted black bikini bottom with clean lines and subtle refined detailing, her legs extend in an elegant slightly offset pose, the over-the-knee boots disappear and she becomes naturally barefoot.

The final transformation cannot finish until the master blade has covered and moved beyond both feet. When it leaves below the tips of both feet at 00:13.000, the black bikini outfit, extended pose and warm expression are complete.

FINAL HOLD — 00:13.000 to 00:15.000: preserve the final black bikini styling without further transformation. The fan continues rotating clockwise. The woman maintains the elegant final pose, with the final arm placement staying close to the previous trench-coat pose and showing only a restrained adjustment, blinks once and holds a subtle natural smile. A few strands of hair and the black bikini fabric respond gently to the airflow. End with the same completely fixed overhead composition, without text, logo or fade.

HARD CONSTRAINTS: exactly three transformations; one complete styling transformation per valid master-blade sweep; every valid sweep starts above the woman’s hair and finishes below both shoes; the master blade’s cumulative path must cover the complete head-to-toe silhouette; no body part may be skipped; outfit, pose and expression change only behind the master blade.

Avoid transformation limited to the upper body, instant full-body replacement, global flash transformation, changes ahead of the blade, other blades triggering changes, crossfade, dissolve, fabric melting, uncontrolled morphing, magical glow, facial identity drift, exaggerated expression, body distortion, duplicated limbs, malformed hands, fused fingers, disconnected anatomy, unnatural joints, exposed underwear, wardrobe malfunction, fan reversal, fan wobble, disappearing blades, shortened blades, changed blade count, background movement, sofa deformation or camera movement.

overall_soundscape: A steady low ceiling-fan motor hum continues throughout, accompanied by rhythmic wooden-blade whooshes and subtle fabric movement. Each valid full-body sweep begins with a stronger air-whoosh above the woman’s head and continues directionally until the blade moves beyond both shoes. No dialogue and no voiceover.

non_diegetic_music: A polished instrumental fashion-electronic track at approximately 108 BPM, using clean bass pulses, restrained percussion, soft synthesizer chords and light metallic accents. The three full-body transformation sweeps begin on beat accents near 2.0, 6.0 and 10.0 seconds and resolve near 5.0, 9.0 and 13.0 seconds. The music remains continuous and ends with a controlled sustained chord.
